title: Coefficient compatibility of the chosen compact-support Frobenius transport
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum $(p,a,q,k_0,k)$ of [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne p$, and finite extensions $E\subset M$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ in a fixed algebraic closure. Let $X_0$ be separated of finite type over $k_0$, put $X=X_0\times_{k_0}k$ and $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$, and fix one compactification of $X_0\to\operatorname{Spec}k_0$ over $k_0$. Use its base change and the specified compactification-relative Frobenius exchange of [def-weil-frobenius-square-exchange] at all coefficient levels. Work in the framework rationalized categories [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi], with $T=-\otimes_E M$. Write $G_E=Lg_{X,E}^*$, $G_M=Lg_{X,M}^*$ for geometric-Frobenius pullback [def-weil-frobenius-detailed, def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], and $C_E=R\Gamma_c(X,-)$, $C_M=R\Gamma_c(X,-)$ [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support, def-weil-finite-coefficient-point]. Let $t_{E,K}:C_EK\to C_EG_EK$ and $t_{M,TK}:C_MTK\to C_MG_MTK$ be the actual compact-support transports of [def-weil-frobenius-cohomology-transport].

For every $K\in D^b_c(X,E)$ let $d_K:T G_EK\xrightarrow{\sim}G_MTK$ be the rationalization of the canonical pullback scalar comparison [lem-pur-integral-operations-scalar-extension], and let $b_K:C_EK\otimes_E M\xrightarrow{\sim}C_MTK$ be the compact-support operation comparison [lem-fix-operation-reduction] followed by the sections comparison [lem-weil-point-sections-scalar-extension]. Then
$$C_M(d_K)b_{G_EK}(t_{E,K}\otimes_E M)=t_{M,TK}b_K.$$
This equation is natural in $K$ and compatible with the specified identity and successive-field-extension comparisons. It concerns the chosen strict-system exchange before realization, and hence its integral realization and rationalization, without any finite Tor-amplitude assumption on reductions. The canonical pullback scalar comparisons used in this equation also commute with the canonical composition identifications for successive Frobenius pullbacks.
